title: Auxiliary Power Unit (APU)
summary: AlliedSignal (now Honeywell Aerospace) G-250 gas-turbine Auxiliary Power Unit housed in the center/aft fuselage spine for autonomous ground electrical and engine-start power.
role: Drives ground electrical/environmental systems and provides pneumatic/shaft start power to spool the F119 engines without external carts.
